addr: 8th C, 24, New Post Office Road, 4th T Block East, 4th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011, India

rev.t: This is one of the small party hall in Jayanagar. You can accommodate upto 100 people in the party hall and there is no dedicated dining hall to serve food, but you can adjust within the party hall. The place is in narrow road and you won't …
Hall could easily accommodate 200 people.  Separate dining hall was provided.  Food for birthday party was awesome.

It used to be very good, but has become very bad nowadays. Located at a very convenient place. In a/c room, we pay for the a/c, and don't feel the coolness in summer. The toilets are horrible, in a cramped place. Food is somewhat OK, but when you do visit the kitchen, you'll feel sorry you ate food from here! Needs much improvement.
